title: Staircase, Glass Balustrade & Steelwork
activity: Steel staircases, landings, treads, glass balustrades and handrails
status: Draft spot check from ITPs – for agreement

questions.q: Stringers/spine beams in position, on line, level and plumb?
All connections bolted with washers and nuts, torque marks on every bolt?
Anchors fully embedded and tight, edge distances kept, resin cured before loading?
Site welds complete, coating damage touched up?
Stair stable – no movement when walked?
Ask the fitter: What distance off the wall should the handrail be? Could they answer?
questions.source: SuperPrime site practice – a fitter who can't answer is a red flag

questions.q: Rise and going consistent through the flight (measure 3 steps)?
questions.source: Alpine stair ITP ALG-00002 install 4.4–4.5; handover 2.2–2.3

questions.q: Treads level, secure, nosings aligned, joints/gaps even?
Landings at the right level, decking fixed, edge trims complete?
Headroom clear over the full flight?
Guarding at least 1100 mm (handrail 900–1000 mm on stairs); no movement when pushed?

guide.title: Guarding & handrail heights
rows: equal all the way up (BM-42: 4–5 mm out was rejected)
guide.note: Drawing dimension governs where it is higher.
guide.src: Approved Document K; Block 5 benchmarks BM-41/42

questions.q: Glass seated in the channel, setting blocks and retention complete, gaskets/sealant finished?
Glass free from chips/scratches, panels aligned with even gaps?
Handrail smooth and continuous, joints neat, ends/returns finished?

guide.title: Handrail – SJWS benchmark
rows: equal on every flight (4–5 mm out was rejected)
ground and polished; outer mitres rounded
level, tight to the rail; countersunk socket screws
straight – no bends, bumps or paint residue

questions.q: Paint/powder coat, stainless and timber free from damage; exposed fixings finished?
Glass and finished treads protected; adjacent finishes undamaged?
questions.source: Alpine stair ITP ALG-00002 install 6.11, 9.9; handover 5.11

notOk.t: Handrail not an equal distance from the wall (4–5 mm out recorded)
Welds not ground and polished; mitres not smooth
Base plates too low or fixings proud
Paint not as smooth as the sample / ripples

ask.q: What height is the guarding and handrail?
ask.a: Guarding at least 1100 mm; stair handrail 900–1000 mm.

ask.q: How are the posts fixed and tested?
ask.a: As the approved fixing detail – 10% pull-tested.

ask.q: What gaps are allowed in the infill?
ask.a: No opening a 100 mm sphere can pass through.
